subject: Agriculture
title: Farmer Field Schools
description: A short lesson to help you apply Farmer Field Schools.

hook.text: In the 1980s, Indonesian rice farmers were overusing pesticides and making pest problems worse. Education fixed it.

buildup.text: Farmer Field Schools teach groups of 25 farmers to observe their own fields—counting pests and their predators.

discovery.text: Farmers learned that spraying killed natural enemies, causing pest resurgence. Doing less produced more.

twist.text: FFS-trained farmers reduced pesticide use by 60% while maintaining or increasing yields and profits.

climax.text: Over 10 million farmers across Asia and Africa have graduated from Farmer Field Schools.

punchline.text: The best pest control tool is a trained human eye.

quiz.question: What key insight did Farmer Field School participants gain?
options: Spraying killed natural enemies and caused pest resurgence
